C101.notes: SER EU-IE-001. National side Celtic harp (cláirseach) · éire left · 2002 right · 12 EU stars · user shorthand 2 and 1 both 2002 + photo (right flip). First calendar year of euro cash in Ireland — punt gone overnight, Brian Boru’s harp on the smallest copper. Country #20 — first Ireland in the vault. Someone paid the odd cent on a bus ticket or a corner-shop sweet with the harp that still means the Republic. SER siblings: EU-IE-002 · EU-IE-003. Ireland flips now 3.
C101.mint: Irish Mint / Central Bank of Ireland (no letter on national side)
C101.story: A 2002 Irish 1-euro-cent coin. Ireland's side shows the Celtic harp, the national symbol, designed by Jarlath Hayes, with the word ÉIRE (Ireland). The other side, shared by every euro country, was designed by Luc Luycx. Struck in copper-plated steel.
